        // ── PRINT SAFETY NET ──
        // Print CSS already forces reveal-on-scroll/bars visible, but two things
        // CSS cannot fix: (1) collapsed <details> simply don't print their
        // content, and (2) finding cards hidden by a severity filter
        // (display:none) vanish from the printout. Snapshot + normalize before
        // printing, restore after.
        const _printRestore = [];
        function _preparePrint() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.reveal-on-scroll').forEach(el => el.classList.add('is-visible'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.animated-bar').forEach(el => el.classList.add('bar-visible'));
            document.querySelectorAll('details:not([open])').forEach(d => {
                _printRestore.push(() => d.removeAttribute('open'));
                d.setAttribute('open', '');
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('.finding-card-v2').forEach(card => {
                if (card.style.display === 'none') {
                    _printRestore.push(() => { card.style.display = 'none'; });
                    card.style.display = 'block';
                }
            });
            // Re-render responsive charts for the reflowed (sidebar-less) print
            // layout — otherwise the canvas can print stretched or blank.
            if (window.Chart && Chart.instances) {
                Object.values(Chart.instances).forEach(c => { try { c.resize(); } catch (e) {} });
                _printRestore.push(() => {
                    Object.values(Chart.instances).forEach(c => { try { c.resize(); } catch (e) {} });
                });
            }
        }
        function _restoreAfterPrint() {
            while (_printRestore.length) _printRestore.pop()();
        }
        window.addEventListener('beforeprint', _preparePrint);
        window.addEventListener('afterprint', _restoreAfterPrint);
        // Safari < 16 fallback: matchMedia-based print detection
        if (window.matchMedia) {
            window.matchMedia('print').addEventListener?.('change', (mq) => {
                if (mq.matches) _preparePrint(); else _restoreAfterPrint();
            });
        }

        // ── FORMAT BEFORE/AFTER COMPARISON PANELS ──
        function formatBeforeAfterBlocks() {
            const bodies = document.querySelectorAll(".finding-row-body, .finding-leftover");

            bodies.forEach(body => {
                const items = Array.from(body.querySelectorAll("li, p"));

                let i = 0;
                while (i < items.length) {
                    const el = items[i];
                    const strong = el.querySelector("strong");
                    if (!strong) {
                        i++;
                        continue;
                    }

                    const text = strong.textContent.trim().replace(/:$/, "").trim().toLowerCase();
                    if (text === "before" || text === "before:") {
                        // Found a "Before" block!
                        // Search for a corresponding "After" block within the next 4 elements
                        let afterEl = null;
                        let afterIndex = -1;

                        for (let j = i + 1; j < Math.min(i + 5, items.length); j++) {
                            const nextEl = items[j];
                            const nextStrong = nextEl.querySelector("strong");
                            if (nextStrong) {
                                const nextText = nextStrong.textContent.trim().replace(/:$/, "").trim().toLowerCase();
                                if (nextText === "after" || nextText === "after:") {
                                    afterEl = nextEl;
                                    afterIndex = j;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        // Locate code pre blocks
                        let preBefore = el.querySelector("pre");
                        if (!preBefore && el.nextElementSibling && el.nextElementSibling.tagName === "PRE") {
                            preBefore = el.nextElementSibling;
                        }

                        let preAfter = null;
                        if (afterEl) {
                            preAfter = afterEl.querySelector("pre");
                            if (!preAfter && afterEl.nextElementSibling && afterEl.nextElementSibling.tagName === "PRE") {
                                preAfter = afterEl.nextElementSibling;
                            }
                        }

                        if (preBefore && preAfter) {
                            // Style the badges beautifully
                            strong.className = "before-badge";
                            strong.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:12px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:4px;">warning</span>Original Code (Before)';

                            const afterStrong = afterEl.querySelector("strong");
                            afterStrong.className = "after-badge";
                            afterStrong.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:12px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:4px;">gpp_good</span>Remediated Code (After)';

                            preBefore.className = "pre-before";
                            preAfter.className = "pre-after";

                            // Create the side-by-side comparison grid container (use <li> if inside a list)
                            const isList = el.tagName === "LI" || (el.parentNode && (el.parentNode.tagName === "UL" || el.parentNode.tagName === "OL"));
                            const grid = document.createElement(isList ? "li" : "div");
                            grid.className = "grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4 my-4" + (isList ? " list-none" : "");

                            const divBefore = document.createElement("div");
                            divBefore.className = "flex flex-col";
                            while (el.firstChild) {
                                divBefore.appendChild(el.firstChild);
                            }
                            if (preBefore.parentNode === el.parentNode) {
                                divBefore.appendChild(preBefore);
                            }

                            const divAfter = document.createElement("div");
                            divAfter.className = "flex flex-col";
                            while (afterEl.firstChild) {
                                divAfter.appendChild(afterEl.firstChild);
                            }
                            if (preAfter.parentNode === afterEl.parentNode) {
                                divAfter.appendChild(preAfter);
                            }

                            grid.appendChild(divBefore);
                            grid.appendChild(divAfter);

                            el.parentNode.insertBefore(grid, el);
                            el.remove();
                            afterEl.remove();

                            // Advance index past the After element we processed
                            i = afterIndex + 1;
                            continue;
                        } else if (preBefore) {
                            // Only "Before" block found without "After"
                            strong.className = "before-badge";
                            strong.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:12px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:4px;">warning</span>Original Code (Before)';
                            preBefore.className = "pre-before";

                            if (el.tagName === "LI") {
                                el.style.listStyleType = "none";
                                el.style.paddingLeft = "0";
                                el.style.marginLeft = "0";
                            }
                        }
                    } else if (text === "after" || text === "after:") {
                        // Individual "After" block without "Before"
                        let preAfter = el.querySelector("pre");
                        if (!preAfter && el.nextElementSibling && el.nextElementSibling.tagName === "PRE") {
                            preAfter = el.nextElementSibling;

                            strong.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined" style="font-size:12px;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:4px;">gpp_good</span>Remediated Code (After)';
                            preAfter.className = "pre-after";

                            if (el.tagName === "LI") {
                                el.style.listStyleType = "none";
                                el.style.paddingLeft = "0";
                                el.style.marginLeft = "0";
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    i++;

🔒 Security & Deployment Review

Summary

Security posture overview: Audit conducted against Built-in Security Baselines (OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25, Docker & Cloud Run Hardening, and GCP IAM Best Practices).

The audit identified critical vulnerabilities and deployment misconfigurations across container build configurations, CI/CD pipeline artifact management, Dockerfile packaging, and Terraform Infrastructure-as-Code definitions. Most notably: 1. Cleartext authentication/authorization tokens are passed as build arguments and persisted as image environment variables (ARG/ENV). 2. Sensitive .env files and Workload Identity STS credentials files (sts-creds.json) are generated in the root workspace without .gitignore / .dockerignore containment. 3. The container image fails to package the core agent_guardian application module, leading to fatal startup failures on Cloud Run. 4. Datadog IaC definitions expose sensitive keys in plan logs and rely on hardcoded local credential file paths.

Findings

[Critical] Dockerfile:5-9 — Sensitive Authentication & Authorization Tokens Embedded in Container Environment (ARG/ENV)

  • Rule: [Built-in baseline: OWASP A02:2021 – Cryptographic Failures / CWE-526: Exposure of Sensitive Information Through Environmental Variables / CWE-200] Secrets, API keys, and authentication/authorization tokens must never be declared via Dockerfile ARG/ENV directives or baked into container image layers.
  • Threat: Declaring ARG DEV_GNE_AUTHENTICATION_TOKEN and ARG DEV_GNE_AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN and assigning them to ENV permanently bakes cleartext authorization tokens into image layer metadata and build history. Anyone with read access to the Artifact Registry repository (docker inspect, docker history, or registry pull) can extract these tokens.
  • Fix:
# Dockerfile: Remove ARG/ENV token persistence
FROM python:3.11.9-slim-bookworm

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    APP_HOME=/app

WORKDIR $APP_HOME

COPY requirements/container.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r container.txt

# Copy both application modules and API gateway
COPY agent_guardian $APP_HOME/agent_guardian
COPY api $APP_HOME/api

RUN useradd -ms /bin/bash -u 10001 appuser && chown -R appuser:appuser $APP_HOME
USER appuser

CMD ["fastapi", "run", "api/main.py", "--port", "8080"]
  • Defense in Depth: Retrieve sensitive credentials dynamically at runtime via Google Cloud Secret Manager or inject them as runtime environment variables directly in the Cloud Run service configuration rather than passing them during image build.
